text: @andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite 是一款面向 DSH CLI profile 的插件与代理技能套件。它通过一个 bundle 注册模型路由和项目上下文插件，并把本包的技能目录交给 DSH 技能文件系统发现。套件还包含任务拆分与编排、审查循环和精简开发风格等技能。适合希望一次安装这些 DSH 扩展的用户；模型路由和凭据由用户在自己的 profile 中配置。

@andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite bundles model routing, project context, and nine agent skills for DSH. Its patch registers two plugins and exposes the included skills for task planning, orchestration, reviews, and concise development. Set model routes and credentials in your profile.
想一次给 DSH 装上模型路由、项目上下文和一组代理技能。
能不能把常用的 DSH 插件和技能打包成一次 profile 安装？
I want to add model routing, project context, and a set of agent skills to one DSH profile in one install.
@andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite 的功能「统一装配 DSH 扩展」：bundle 为 profile 注册模型路由与项目上下文插件，并把包内 skills/ 设为技能发现目录；安装后重启 harness 生效。

@andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite README · dsh-suite：[](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Plugins and agent skills for [DSH](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh), installable in one command. After a restart of the harness, the profile has virtual model ids with automatic failover, cold-start project context in every new session, and nine agent skills wired in — routes and credentials stay yours.

@andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite README · What's inside：| Piece | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`dsh-model-router`](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/dsh-model-router) | plugin | Virtual model ids routed over real provider/model candidates — priority failover, round-robin rotation, sleep windows |
| [`deep-horizon`](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/deep-horizon) | plugin | Injects the project's horizon (open gaps + about line) into every new session — cold-start project context shared across harnesses |
| strong-orchestrator | skill | Sequential implement → review-loop orchestration with a persistent implementer |
| dex / dex-plan | skills | Task hierarchies: epics, subtasks, verification via the dex CLI |
| ponytail (+ audit, debt, gain, help, review) | skills | Lazy-senior-dev output style family: shortest working diff wins |

@andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite README · What's inside：Standalone siblings that don't ride in this bundle: [archloop](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/archloop) (overnight architecture-improvement loop driver) and [hkrc](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/hkrc) (Hermes Kanban blocker recovery controller).

@andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite README · Install：Requires a DSH profile to install into:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite
```

That command installs this package, pulls the plugin dependencies (`@andrepontesmelo/dsh-model-router` and `deep-horizon`), and registers the bundle patch, which points DSH skill discovery at the nine bundled skills. Restart the harness and every suite piece is live in that profile.

@andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite README · Install：Both dependencies are pinned to release tags (`deep-horizon#v0.2.0`, `@andrepontesmelo/dsh-model-router#v0.2.1`), so what an install pulls cannot drift between installs — pin your install the same way (tag) rather than floating on a branch. This bundle registers nine agent skills into the target profile; audit a bundle you did not write before installing it.

It's working if, after a restart:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> list

@andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite README · Develop：```bash
npm test   # structural gate: 9 skills present, valid names/frontmatter, bundle wiring intact
```
